name: shop-mcp
description: Answer questions about a Shopify store's catalogue and stock. Read-only.
long_description: A read-only Shopify Admin API server. Four tools: full-text product search, one product with every variant's SKU/price/stock, per-location inventory (available / committed / on-hand), and a low-stock report sorted by shortfall. No write operation exists in the code. Single file, Python standard library only - no MCP SDK and no GraphQL client, so there is nothing to install. The bundle ships its own test suite, and every file each check needs travels with it: run 'python3 shop_mcp.py --self-test' with no credentials and no network to see 189 assertions, and 'bash mutation_test.sh' to see 23 known defects injected into copies of the source and each caught by a named assertion.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find products in the store by free text, vendor, or status.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Read one product in full, including every variant with its SKU, price and stock level.

tools.name: check_inventory
tools.description: Stock for a SKU broken down by location, with available, committed and on-hand counts.

tools.name: low_stock_report
tools.description: Variants at or below a stock threshold, lowest first.

admin_token.title: Admin API access token
admin_token.description: A Shopify Admin API token. Read scopes are enough: read_products and read_inventory.
